title: Highway & Road Works Supervision
details: Day-to-day supervision of road construction and improvement works: GSB, WMM, DBM, BM and BC layers; compaction, thickness and level checks; work to MoRTH specifications and IRC codes.

title: Drainage Design & Levels
details: Hydraulic design and level calculations for roadside drains and outfalls: discharge and drain capacity checks, invert level and longitudinal slope design, drain levels set from the FRL (finished road level).

title: Quality Assurance & Control
details: Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), coordination of material and field tests, hold points, inspections and quality records.

title: NCR Management
details: Closing out Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs): root cause and corrective action, technical replies to the client and PMC, NCR status tracking until close-out.

title: Work Methodologies
details: Method statements for bituminous works (BC, BM, DBM), short panel concrete (SPC) pavement and paver blocks, with equipment, sequence, safety and an ITP for each activity.

title: Quantity & Cost Estimation
details: Quantity take-off and cost sheets, material inventory tracking, project correspondence and document trackers.

title: Road & Drain Improvement — Package 03
details: Imphal East Division (ED-2), Manipur. Role: Site and QA/QC Engineer. Supervision of pavement layers and roadside drains; drain hydraulic and invert-level checks; inspection, testing and NCR close-out; coordination with the PWD division and PMC. Outcome: works carried out to specification, with documented inspections and NCRs tracked to closure.

title: Road & Drain Improvement — Package 04
details: Highway South Division, Manipur. Role: Site and QA/QC Engineer. Bituminous works supervision (DBM, BC); roadside drain construction and levels; quality records and NCR replies; project email and document tracking. Outcome: a consistent quality and reporting system shared across both packages.

title: Roadside Drain Hydraulic & Invert-Level Design
details: Packages 03 & 04, Manipur. Role: Design and Calculation Engineer. Drain capacity and velocity checks; invert levels and longitudinal slopes, chainage by chainage; drain levels matched to the FRL and road profile; reusable Excel calculation templates. Standards: IRC:SP:42 and IRC:SP:50 guidance. Outcome: repeatable calculation sheets that give consistent drain levels for every stretch.

title: Methodologies & ITPs for Paving Works
details: Packages 03 & 04, Manipur. Role: QA/QC Engineer. BC, BM and DBM methodologies; short panel concrete (SPC) and paver block methodologies; an ITP for each activity with hold and witness points; equipment lists, sequence and safety measures. Outcome: site-ready method statements that site teams can follow layer by layer.

title: NCR Reply & Close-out System
details: Packages 03 & 04, Manipur. Role: QA/QC Engineer. Technical replies with root cause and corrective action; photo and test evidence for each NCR; a status tracker for open and closed NCRs. Outcome: NCRs tracked to closure, with a clear status picture for the client at any time.

title: Project Email & Document Tracker
details: Packages 03 & 04, Manipur. Role: Project Engineer. Email and letter register for each package; submission and approval status tracking; quick search by date, subject and reference. Outcome: every letter and reply is easy to find, and pending responses are easy to spot.

title: Profile
details: Shaikh Sayeed Ahmed is a freelance civil engineer specialising in highways, drainage and quality control (QA/QC). He is based in Manipur, India, works on Public Works Department (PWD) road and drainage projects, and is available for projects across North-East India.

title: Standards
details: Works to the MoRTH Specifications for Road & Bridge Works and IRC codes, including IRC:37 (flexible pavement design), IRC:SP:42 (road drainage), IRC:SP:50 (urban drainage), IRC:SP:63 (interlocking concrete block pavement) and IRC:SP:112 (quality control for road and bridge works).

title: Software
details: MS Excel calculation workbooks, MS Word, and AI tools for engineering documentation.

title: How to hire
details: Use the contact form on the Contact page with your name, email, the service needed and project details. Sayeed replies within 1–2 working days.

title: Availability
details: Available for freelance, contract and consultancy work on road and drainage projects.

title: Pricing
details: Each project is quoted individually after reviewing the scope, location and timeline. Send the project details through the contact form to get a quote.

title: Location
details: Based in Manipur, India. Available for projects across North-East India.

title: Work process
details: 1. Understand: discuss scope, drawings, specifications and deadlines. 2. Plan: prepare calculations, methodology or ITP and agree deliverables. 3. Deliver: site supervision, inspections and documents with regular updates. 4. Close out: final records, NCR close-out and a clean hand-over file.
